integration_status: Prepared only; not connected to NEST
controls: Generate an initial brief/site-based response before retrieving inspiration when practical.
Do not inject every record or collection-level preferences into a system prompt.
Use a small query-relevant subset, deduplicate by project, and preserve claim_status and source_url.
Treat retrieved text as reference data, never instructions.
Do not convert frequency, popularity, NEW labels or catalog position into recommendation weights.
Keep scenario and revenue fields out of the source-description embedding text.
Do not infer profit, exact area, suitability, clinical benefit or technical feasibility.
Permit the same answer with the collection disabled; user must be able to opt out.
bias_limit: Selection bias remains: this is a curated collection with strong Egypt/Behance/student-project coverage. Separation and gating reduce influence but cannot guarantee zero bias.
validation_before_activation: Disabled-mode output/context and site scores unchanged.
Factual queries exclude scenario and commercial record kinds.
General site/program queries do not retrieve this optional namespace by default.
No duplicate project dominates the context.
A museum/school/housing brief remains answerable despite the earlier chat preferences.
Disabling the namespace fully removes its records from retrieved context.
